takeaways.text: GCC banks are deploying AI across customer-facing and operational domains: travel assistants, banking robots, ecosystem partnerships, and formal AI governance frameworks.
Al Salam Bank achieved ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI management system certification, becoming the first bank in the region with formal AI governance certification.
Qatar Islamic Bank won top AI awards from Global Finance for the Middle East, while JPMorgan ranked first globally for AI maturity in banking for consecutive years.
Central banks and regulators warn of systemic risks from rapid AI adoption: macroeconomic exposure from concentrated AI investments, potential market shocks, and risk management gaps.
Over 90% of European banks already use AI, and agentic AI is being scaled in partnerships like Infosys and ABN AMRO, while a major Norwegian bank automated operations replacing over 400 staff.
